title: Hezekiah’s Prayer and God’s Answer

questions.question: What did Hezekiah do when he heard the words of the Rabshakeh?
options: He tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: He tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 19:1 (ESV): "...he tore his clothes and covered himself with sackcloth and went into the house of the LORD."

questions.question: Who did Hezekiah send messengers to?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 19:2 (ESV): "And he sent... to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz."

questions.question: What did Isaiah prophesy about the king of Assyria?
options: He shall not come into this city or shoot an arrow there
questions.correctAnswer: He shall not come into this city or shoot an arrow there
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 19:32 (ESV): "Therefore thus says the LORD concerning the king of Assyria: He shall not come into this city or shoot an arrow there..."

questions.question: What happened to the Assyrian army?
options: The angel of the LORD struck down 185,000 in the camp
questions.correctAnswer: The angel of the LORD struck down 185,000 in the camp
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 19:35 (ESV): "And that night the angel of the LORD went out and struck down 185,000 in the camp of the Assyrians..."

questions.question: How did Sennacherib die?
options: His sons Adrammelech and Sharezer struck him down with the sword while he was worshiping
questions.correctAnswer: His sons Adrammelech and Sharezer struck him down with the sword while he was worshiping
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 19:37 (ESV): "And as he was worshiping... Adrammelech and Sharezer, his sons, struck him down with the sword..."

questions.question: What rumor did the king of Assyria hear that caused him to turn back?
options: The king of Cush (Tirhakah) had set out to fight against him
The king of Egypt was coming
questions.correctAnswer: The king of Cush (Tirhakah) had set out to fight against him
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 19:9 (ESV): "Now the king heard concerning Tirhakah king of Cush, 'Behold, he has set out to fight against you.'"

questions.question: What did Hezekiah do with the letter from the messengers?
options: He spread it before the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: He spread it before the LORD
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 19:14 (ESV): "Hezekiah received the letter... and went up to the house of the LORD and spread it before the LORD."

questions.question: Who did Isaiah say Sennacherib had actually mocked and reviled?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 19:22 (ESV): "Whom have you mocked and reviled?... Against the Holy One of Israel!"

questions.question: What sign did the Lord give Hezekiah regarding the remnant?
options: This year you shall eat what grows of itself, and in the second year what springs of the same
questions.correctAnswer: This year you shall eat what grows of itself, and in the second year what springs of the same
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 19:29 (ESV): "And this shall be the sign for you: this year you shall eat what grows of itself..."

questions.question: Why did God say He would defend the city?
options: For my own sake and for the sake of my servant David
questions.correctAnswer: For my own sake and for the sake of my servant David
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 19:34 (ESV): "For I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake and for the sake of my servant David."

questions.question: Where was Rabshakeh when he sent messengers to Hezekiah the second time?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 19:8 (ESV): "The Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria fighting against Libnah..."

questions.question: Who was the god of Sennacherib?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 19:37 (ESV): "And as he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god..."

questions.question: How did God describe Sennacherib's rage against Him?
options: I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth
questions.correctAnswer: I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 19:28 (ESV): "Because you have raged against me... I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth..."

questions.question: What gods did Hezekiah mention that the Assyrians destroyed?
options: Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the people of Eden
questions.correctAnswer: Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the people of Eden
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 19:12 (ESV): "Have the gods of the nations delivered them... Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the people of Eden..."

questions.question: What did the survivors in the Assyrian camp find in the morning?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 19:35 (ESV): "...And when people arose early in the morning, behold, these were all dead bodies."

key_verse_text: So now, O LORD our God, save us, please, from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you, O LORD, are God alone. (ESV)
